system: Qwen2.5-3B primary model with independent BioGPT-Large agreement gate
checkpoint_selection_rule: Qwen epoch 1 was selected using validation loss before final test evaluation.
acceptance_rule: Accept only when Qwen predicts yes, BioGPT independently predicts yes, and Qwen meets a validation-selected confidence threshold.
threshold_selection_rule: Maximum validation coverage with zero observed true-no to predicted-yes false accepts.
